title: LIVE: Bury Road in Bamford cordoned off as emergency services attend house explosion
excerpt: Bury Road in Bamford is cordoned off after an explosion at a house at 5.10pm on Tuesday, with debris across the road. A witness said her house shook violently.
body:
Bury Road in Bamford has been cordoned off after an explosion at a house at 5.10pm on Tuesday 17 November, leaving debris across the road.

All emergency services were sent to the scene. Police and the fire service are there now.

A witness, Carol Scott, described it as a suspected gas explosion. The cause has not been confirmed by the emergency services.

Ms Scott said: “Just been an explosion at a house on Bury Road, Bamford, suspected gas explosion. Debris all over Bury Road which is cordoned off. Police and the fire service are at the scene now. Our house shook violently, I thought a plane had landed on us, it was very scary.”

There is no confirmed information yet about any injuries.

This story will be updated as more information becomes available.

Source: Rochdale Daily newsdesk and witness Carol Scott, 17 November 2026.

live_updates.text: A huge explosion has been heard in Bamford. All emergency services are in attendance on Bury Road.

Witness Carol Scott says the explosion was at a house on Bury Road and describes it as a suspected gas explosion. Bury Road is cordoned off with debris across the road; police and the fire service are at the scene. Ms Scott said her house "shook violently".
